Os gregos são bons em reconhecimento, po: The Greeks are good at reconnaissance, as they start with a land-based Kataskopos and can train flying Pegasi in the Temple. Worshipers of Poseidon also receive a Hippocampus when building a Dock. Greek soldiers tend to be stronger and more expensive than those from other civilizations. The Greeks can only train a handful of Heroes at a time, but they are all exceptionally strong. Greek heroes also train faster and have greater damage against mythical units in later eras. They gain Favor by praying in Temples.

o Camponês e o Kuafu . Os camponeses são: the Peasant and the Kuafu. Peasants are less efficient than Villagers from other cultures, but they are supported by the Kuafu, powerful giants who excel in building buildings.

Unidades e edifícios aliados na área alv: Allied units and buildings in the target area will quickly recover health for 8 seconds. Outside of combat, this power can almost instantly restore any normal unit to full health. The recovery rate is greatly reduced during combat.
Edifícios na área alvo tornarão as unida: Buildings in the target area will slow down units and prevent attack for 60 seconds. However, this power does not affect City Centers.

Transforma todos os soldados humanos, un: Turns all human soldiers, mythic (exceto Titãs) units, and player ships in the target area bronze for 40 seconds, reducing their hacking and piercing vulnerabilities by -35%.
Transforma unidades inimigas aleatórias: Transforms random enemy units in the target area into pigs, with an upper limit on the resource cost of the transformed units. This power does not affect mythic* units or heroes, and has a reduced impact on Villagers
Cria um Cofre que gera 4 unidades de com: Creates a Vault that generates 4 units of food, wood and gold every second. The Vault cannot be destroyed. Instead, it can be captured by enemy units and will be taken by the player who has the most units near the Vault.
Cria uma tempestade violenta na área alv: Creates a violent storm in the target area. Lightning can hit enemy units, causing them great damage. The more units there are in the area, the greater the damage caused. This power does not affect own or allied (antes of Retold , also não afetava units voadoras ) units and is less effective against structures.
Causa enormes quantidades de dano de esm: Deals massive amounts of crushing damage over a wide area in the target area - with more damage being dealt in the center of the area of ​​effect and less at the edges. This power has no effect on Farms.
Por 55 segundos, cria uma escuridão sobr: For 55 seconds, creates a darkness over the entire map, which increases the player's Mythic Units and Landmarks. Mythic units gain +20% attack (incluindo habilidades), -60% skill cooldown, +15% movement speed, and -10% slashing / -10% piercing / -10% crushing vulnerabilities. Transporta instantaneamente um grupo de: Instantly transport a group of allied units from one target location on the map to another. Before Retold, this could be used to move friendly and enemy units; however, enemy units to be transported were randomly selected, with a much lower chance of being transported compared to allied units.
Invoca Serpentes aliadas para proteger o: Summons allied Serpents to protect the target location. The player has no control over the snakes, but shares their Line of Sight. If this power is invoked in water, Sea Serpents will be summoned in its place.
Invoca um enxame de gafanhotos para atac: Summons a swarm of locusts to attack in the indicated direction. The swarm will damage all units and buildings, as well as dealing heavy damage to Villagers and Fishing Boats, as well as quickly destroying Farms, Fruit Bushes and animals. Before Retold, it did not damage other units or buildings, but was very effective in devastating the opponent's economy. It affected a single area and moved randomly. In Retold, the power used a directional target, and the swarm moved in a straight line.
Ressuscita os mortos por 55 segundos no: Resurrects the dead for 55 seconds at the target location. On land, Minions will be summoned, while on water, Lost Ships will appear. Ancestors are gradually resurrected and will be dismissed together when the effect expires.
Transforma o Centro da Cidade aliado alv: Transforms the target allied Town Center into a Citadel Center, a durable structure with significantly increased attack, hit points, armor, and work rate. The Citadel also supports additional population. In Retold, each civilization uses its own unique architecture for the Citadel rather than always appearing in Egyptian design, with the only difference being the main statue of the god.
Transforma o Faraó alvo em um Filho de O: Transforms the target Pharaoh into a Son of Osiris, a unit with greatly increased attack and hit points, as well as a greater magnitude of power, that uses a lightning chain attack that can hit up to four units at once. A Son of Osiris cannot be healed, and when he dies, an ordinary Pharaoh will replace him. In Retold, it is possible to cast this power again to have multiple Sons of Osiris at the same time.
Por 20 segundos, meteoros cairão sobre a: For 20 seconds, meteors will fall over the target area. The first impact will be in the center of the target, with subsequent impacts spreading out randomly. Meteor impacts deal massive amounts of damage to structures and launch units into the air, dealing moderate damage to them. Meteors can damage allied units and structures, although not to the same extent as enemies.
Cria um tornado violento por 20 segundos: Creates a violent tornado for 20 seconds at the target location, which spreads in a spiral, causing heavy damage to units and structures. The tornado will deal damage to both enemy and allied units.
Incendeia árvores no local alvo, espalha: Ignites trees in the target location, spreading to other trees in a limited radius before they fall. Enemy units and buildings near the flames take damage, while own and allied units and buildings are immune.
Cria uma onda de choque que causa dano a: Creates a shockwave that damages walls, towers, city centers, and fortresses. Crumble is powerful enough to instantly destroy walls and towers, but does limited damage to city centers and fortresses. In Retold, the power uses a directional target.
Cria uma fonte de cura que cura unidades: Creates a healing fountain that heals idle self and friendly units within range at a rate of 2.5 health per second, slower for non-idle units. Anima árvores aleatórias na área alvo. A: Animates random trees in the target area. Walking Forests will attack enemy units and buildings. Prior to patch 2.7, they could not be controlled by the player.
Por 50 segundos, todas as unidades inimi: For 50 seconds, all enemy units in the target area will be frozen in place but will have 99% armor, making them nearly invulnerable to any attacks during this period.
Quando invocado, todas as unidades human: When summoned, all of the player's human units, ships, and heroes on the map will have 60% increased attack for 45 seconds.
Converte instantaneamente todos os Colet: Instantly converts all Collectors and Dwarves on the map into Heroes of Ragnarok, melee infantry units with a huge bonus against mythic units, but unable to collect resources or build Farms. This power essentially sacrifices the player's economy for an instant army.
Por 31 segundos, várias matilhas de Lobo: For 31 seconds, multiple packs of Fimbulwinter Wolves will appear next to enemy Town Centers, Town Centers, or Settlements. The player has no control over the wolves, and they are dismissed when the effect expires. In the original game, no other divine powers can be invoked by any player while Fimbulwinter is in effect.
Invoca o poderoso dragão Nidhogg para se: Summons the powerful dragon Nidhogg to serve the player. Nidhogg is particularly resilient and quite effective against buildings, dealing group damage against groups of enemy units. He is particularly vulnerable to ranged attacks from heroes, towers, and Fortress-type buildings, and cannot be healed in any way.
Coloca ovos de aranha na área alvo, que: Places spider eggs in the target area, which will eventually hatch and burrow into the ground. Este poder transforma instantaneamente u: This power instantly transforms Atlantean units into heroes. In the original game, a group of units can be converted. In Retold, this power only affects one unit, but instantly restores its full health.
Invoca uma planta carnívora anfíbia no l: Summons an amphibious carnivorous plant at target location (terra or água). The plant is stationary, but can devour (e afundar navios before of Retold ) soldiers who approach it.
Concede instantaneamente ao jogador o co: Instantly grants the player control of a selected enemy unit. Cannot be used on economic units, Titans, heroes and other units such as transport units. In Retold, units converted by Traitor will no longer take damage when converted.
No jogo original, esse poder converte im: In the original game, this power immediately converts a group of enemy units in the target area to Mother Nature, making them hostile to all players. In Retold, it bestows a status effect that causes affected units to attack each other. The duration depends on the number of units affected; the more units affected, the shorter the duration of the divine power.
Constrói imediatamente uma Árvore das He: Immediately builds a Tree of Hesperides, where up to 5 (por árvore) Dryads can be created. The tree cannot be destroyed. Instead, it can be captured by enemy or allied units and will be taken by the player who has the most units near the tree.
Cria um \"buraco negro\" esférico, que s: Creates a spherical "black hole", which sucks in and damages nearby units ( exceto units voadoras ) and then explodes, damaging all nearby units and substantial damage to structures. Final explosion damage increases as more units are sucked in.
Teletransporta instantaneamente todas as: Instantly teleports all owned military units across the map to the target location.
